create.name: Sara Landon
create.bio:
Sara Landon is an author, speaker and spiritual teacher best known as the channel for The Council, which she describes as a collective of ascended master beings who first came through when she asked to understand her own purpose. Their message is that each person already carries the wisdom they are looking for and can learn to create their life consciously, from a sense of connection with Source rather than from striving.

She shares this material through books written with or from The Council, among them You Are a Channel, a practical guide to opening your own connection with higher guidance, and The Dream, the Journey, Eternity, and God, a set of question-and-answer sessions with the author Mike Dooley. Her online courses run as guided journeys of fifteen or thirty days on themes such as channelling, prosperity, energy and the spiritual roles of the soul, and a monthly membership gathers students online around a new topic each month. She also mentors leaders and entrepreneurs, and hosts the Journey of the Master podcast, released on her YouTube channel, where she talks through The Council's teachings.

books.title: You Are a Channel: Receive Guidance from Higher Realms, Ascended Masters, Star Families, and More
books.author: Sara Landon
books.description: A step-by-step guide to opening a personal connection with higher guidance, built around fifteen tips drawn from Sara Landon's years of channelling The Council. It includes journaling and automatic-writing practices for readers to try.

books.title: The Dream, the Journey, Eternity, and God: Channeled Answers to Life's Deepest Questions
books.author: Sara Landon and Mike Dooley
books.description: Mike Dooley puts his questions about life, purpose, God and what follows death to The Council over several sessions, and Sara Landon channels the answers. The book is arranged as their conversation.

courses.title: The Mentorship Program
courses.description: A month-to-month online membership with Sara Landon and The Council. Each month centres on one topic, explored live with a community of members.

courses.title: You Are a Channel
courses.description: A 30-day online journey for opening and developing your own connection to higher wisdom. It updates and expands her earlier course on learning to channel.

courses.title: Realize Your Divine Prosperity
courses.description: Six teaching sessions and six channelled activations delivered over 30 days. The course looks at prosperity as a spiritual state that touches every part of life, not only money.

courses.title: Everything Is Energy
courses.description: The replay of a 15-day channelled intensive with Sara Landon and The Council. Participants practise working consciously with energy to shape the reality they live in.

courses.title: Spiritual Roles Mastery
courses.description: A 30-day guided course on the eleven spiritual roles of the soul described in her latest book. It helps students recognise their own gifts and sense of purpose.

courses.title: Your Ultimate Desire
courses.description: A 30-day course on choosing the life you truly want, with play and creativity treated as the most direct way to create. Sold as a replay.

free_resources.title: Journey of the Master Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast of conversations on The Council's teachings, released on the main podcast apps and on YouTube. Episodes run around half an hour to forty-five minutes.
